ExxonMobil Permian Guyana production growth 2026 market share

findings.claim: XOM 2026Q3: Upstream earnings fell vs Q2 on lower crude prices; Energy Products adjusted earnings rose to ~$9.1B from $4.1B on higher margins; Chemical Products $735M reported, down from ~$1.2B in Q2 on lower margins; Specialty Products ~$1.3B on higher base-stock margins (search summary of the press release).
Agencies' oil demand views diverge for 2026 (IEA Aug: contraction of 1.6 mb/d; Strait of Hormuz disruption and EV adoption cited) and converge on a 2027 recovery of about 1.9-2.0 mb/d (July summary).
findings.source: IEF Comparative Analysis of monthly reports on the oil market (Aug 2026)

findings.claim: Guyana fifth FPSO on track to start in Q4 2026 adding 250 kb/d capacity; Permian Q2 2026 production reportedly above 1.8 MMboe/d with plan of ~2.5 MMboe/d by 2030; no market share figure found.
findings.source: Zacks: Will ExxonMobil's Guyana, Permian assets power its upstream business

note: Excerpts not verbatim (summary only). No market share or Oil&Gas Integrated TAM consensus found. as_of for IEF and Zacks approximate.
